LESSON: WRITING 5.5.1 LETTER OF APPLICATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.5: Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we write letters of application?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of a letter of application
2. write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 5.5.1 LETTER OF APPLICATION
This lesson teaches Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the components of a letter of application
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application above.
2. Explain Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 5.5.1 Letter of Application important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we write letters of application?
2. How can one ensure a letter of application meets the expected standards?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the components of a letter of application
2. write a letter of application for placement at Senior School using all the components

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
